title: Sunsetting listing schemas endpoint
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2024-08-26
html:
Summary

The Listing Schema endpoint will be sunset on August 31, 2024.

Affected Markets and API Versions

This change is for all markets and all API versions.

Required Actions

The capabilities of the Listing Schema endpoint can be fulfilled by the Get Attributes and Get Category Rules endpoints, which will remain available. Please transition to using these two endpoints and discontinue using the Listing Schema endpoint in your app by August 31, 2024.
